statement: The existing maintainer-sourced DualSense UAC1 descriptor report establishes a documented 48 kHz S16LE four-output/two-input configuration, channel masks, two mute/volume feature-unit IDs, and isochronous endpoint packet maxima; it does not establish the numeric USB input/output wTerminalType descriptor codes, prove that 48 kHz is the exclusive supported rate, or validate feature-unit gain/mute behavior. Linux's terminal IDs 3 and 4 for jack-state controls must not be mistaken for numeric terminal types. Those remaining physical details are unknown from the reviewed pinned public sources.

applicability.scope: Gap claim supplementing existing audio-dualsense-usb-uac1-topology; public maintainer report and Linux/ALSA consumer code only. No new corpus physical experiment.
